question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Higher**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"High"** means something that is situated at a great distance above the ground or another specified level. (ऊँचा)
 
• **"Higher" **is the **comparative** form of "high," which means more elevated in position. (ऊँचा)
 
 
• **Example: **She scored higher marks in the exam than her classmates.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that given the current circumstances and the sea breeze's delayed setting, the maximum temperature over Goa is probably going to stay 4–6°C above average.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate option for the blank is **'higher'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Higher**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **High **(ऊँचा): Situated at a great distance above the ground or another specified level.

 
 
• **Example:** The mountain is very high.
 
 
 
• **Highly **(अत्यधिक): To a high degree or level.
 
 
• **Example: **She is highly skilled in mathematics.
 
 
 
• **Highest** (सबसे ऊँचा): Of the greatest possible height or level.
 
 
• **Example:** Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
